cloud.title: Speak now with Edge TTS
cloud.description: Hundreds of natural voices work right away — no install, no GPU, just internet.

piper.title: Install local Piper
piper.description: Lightweight ONNX engine that runs on CPU. 50+ languages. Works offline after downloading.

kokoro.title: Boost quality with Kokoro
kokoro.description: Engine with MOS 4.2 in just 300 MB. Still runs on CPU.

xtts.title: Enable cloning with XTTS v2
xtts.description: Clone any voice with a 6-30s sample. Requires an NVIDIA GPU with validated CUDA.

mic.title: Set up the virtual microphone
mic.description: Install VB-Cable, select CABLE Input as output, and set CABLE Output in Discord/VRChat.

shortcuts.title: Create your voice shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Each shortcut triggers a phrase with a fixed voice — works in-game without bringing the app to the front.

nvidiaCuda.headline: Full NVIDIA + CUDA track
nvidiaCuda.summary: You have the premium path unlocked: online Edge TTS, local Piper/Kokoro, and XTTS cloning.
nvidiaCuda.note: CUDA {{version}}. You can enable XTTS v2 whenever you want to clone a voice.

amd.headline: Lightweight track for AMD
amd.summary: On Windows, AMD has no stable GPU TTS framework. You will use the CPU+cloud track — works great for Discord and games.
amd.note1: Piper and Kokoro run directly on your CPU, no special driver needed.
amd.note2: XTTS v2 cloning requires NVIDIA + CUDA, so it is outside your flow. Use online voices — there are hundreds.

intel.headline: CPU + cloud track (Intel)
intel.summary: Intel iGPU does not accelerate TTS in any stable framework. You will use online Edge TTS and lightweight CPU models.
intel.note: Piper was designed to run on modest CPUs. The first utterance takes under 1 second.

cpu.headline: Universal track (no dedicated GPU)
cpu.summary: Online Edge TTS covers everything. Piper can be installed for offline use on CPU.
cpu.note: Detected your machine as CPU tier. Advanced tracks require an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA.

nvidiaNoCuda.headline: NVIDIA detected — no CUDA
nvidiaNoCuda.summary: The GPU is present, but the CUDA Toolkit was not found. Use the CPU+cloud track for now; install CUDA later to unlock cloning.
nvidiaNoCuda.note: Install CUDA Toolkit 11.8+ and reopen the app to enable XTTS and cloning.

hotkey.unsupportedKey: Unsupported key. Use letters, numbers, F1-F24, or arrows.
hotkey.needModifier: Combine with Ctrl or Alt (avoids conflicting with typing).
hotkey.reserved: Hotkey is reserved by the system.

greeting.name: Greeting
greeting.text: Hey everyone, how are you doing?

router.edgeUnavailableNoLocal: Edge unavailable — no local voice installed

model.summary: Start with Piper for a frictionless first local voice.
model.gpuCuda: XTTS v2 can be enabled later as an advanced feature on NVIDIA/CUDA.
model.gpuNoCuda: The reliable local path is Piper and Kokoro.
model.cloneReason: Practical voice cloning requires NVIDIA with validated CUDA.

mic.launchedDownloaded: Downloaded and installer opened. Click "Install Driver" and restart Windows if prompted.
mic.launched: Installer opened. Follow VB-Cable and restart Windows if it asks.
mic.manual: Couldn't install automatically. Download VB-Cable from the official site and come back to check.
mic.error: Couldn't install VB-Cable. Try again or use the official site.

audio.playFailed: Could not play the audio: all strategies failed.
